items.title: Chalkboard Lecture · Physiology (German)
items.description: German physiology lectures on a chalkboard. Every slide is a dense white-chalk textbook plate drawn by Muse on one fixed blackboard: the organ, cell or mechanism the narration explains, usually in two states side by side, with arrows and 6 to 8 German labels taken from the narration - every number sits inside the label that says what it measures, no invented formulas, and a chart only when the narration states a trend. Shot 1 is a hook image that zooms in on where the problem is, turned into a 9-second opening video (gpt-image-2 storyboard, then Muse). Slides dissolve gently into each other (0.8 s). Paste your German script and it is read word for word with the Edge voice de-DE Florian, one slide per paragraph. Needs Content Studio 2026.10.15.115022 or newer and a browser profile signed in to Muse (Cloud API Keys > Muse); 9Router with cx/gpt-image-2 is optional for the opening.
